name: Stationary Bike
cardText:
1
Hold the handles and maintain a neutral spine.
2
Pedal at a moderate pace and try to minimise rocking back and forth.

name: Jump Rope
cardText:
1
Hold handles, elbows close, and jump with both feet together.
2
Rotate wrists to swing the rope over your head.
3
Jump as it reaches your feet, keeping a steady rhythm.

name: Elliptical
cardText:
1
Step onto the pedals, grip the handles, and start moving your feet in a natural stride.
2
Adjust resistance and incline for desired intensity while maintaining a steady, controlled motion.
3
Keep your posture upright, engage your core, and maintain a consistent pace for an effective workout.

name: Butt Kick
cardText:
1
Stand tall, jog in place, bringing heels toward your glutes.
2
Keep your core tight and swing arms naturally.
3
Alternate legs quickly, maintaining a steady rhythm.

name: Cardio Assault Bike Arms Only
cardText:
1
Adjust seat and handlebar height for comfort and proper posture on the assault bike.
2
Start pedaling with even, controlled motion, maintaining your desired resistance level. Then keep the motion going with only your arms.

name: Cardio Assault Bike
cardText:
1
Adjust seat and handlebar height for comfort and proper posture on the assault bike.
2
Start pedaling with even, controlled motion, maintaining your desired resistance level.
3
Monitor heart rate and intensity; increase or decrease resistance for an effective cardio workout.

name: Cardio Band Hammer Curl Jacks
cardText:
1
Stand with a band looped under both feet and the band grasped in both hands.
2
Do a light hop and bring your feet outward while simultaneously flexing the elbows.
3
Bring both feet back together and extend the elbows.

name: Cardio Band Press Jacks
cardText:
1
Stand with the band looped under both feet and the other end of the band in both hands in an overhead press position.
2
Do a light hop and bring both feet outward while pressing the band overhead.

name: Cardio Band Reverse Fly Jacks
cardText:
1
Grab the band with a double overhand grip. Bring both feet outward while performing a little hop.
2
As you hop, pull the band apart.

name: Cardio Band Seal Jacks
cardText:
1
Loop a band around your back. Start with both arms extended at your side.
2
As you perform the jack. Bring both arms together and make a little clap.

name: Cardio Box Quick Feet
cardText:
1
Stay light on your toes and tap both feet to the ground in quick succession.
2
Move in a square pattern.

name: Cardio Criss Cross Jacks
cardText:
1
Perform a jumping jack while crossing the feet.

name: Cardio Diamond Hop
cardText:
1
With both feet, leap forward then back, then to the left, then to the right.
2
Repeat.

name: Cardio Figure Eight Sprint
cardText:
1
Perform s sprint in a figure eight pattern.
2
Make sure to stay low.

name: Cardio Forward Scissor
cardText:
1
Do a light hop and split your stance.
2
Land lightly on your toes, and then bring the opposing leg forward.

name: Cardio In And Out Forward
cardText:
1
Bring one leg forward and then the other.
2
Bring the original leg backwards and then the other.

name: Cardio In And Outs
cardText:
1
Start with both feet together.
2
Do a slight hop and bring your feet outwards, then back inwards.

name: Cardio In In Out Out Shuffle
cardText:
1
Start with your feet side by side.
2
Bring one foot laterally, then the other.
3
Return the first foot to its starting position, then the other.

name: Cardio Jumping Jacks
cardText:
1
Stand with feet together, arms at your sides, ready to jump.
2
Jump while spreading legs and raising arms overhead.
3
Return to starting position with legs together and arms at your sides. Repeat.

name: Cardio Karaoke
cardText:
1
Stand upright, feet together, facing forward, ready to move laterally.
2
Move right foot behind left, then step left foot to the side.
3
Alternate crossing and stepping, increase speed, maintain rhythm and balance.

name: Cardio Knee Taps
cardText:
1
Stand straight, feet hip-width apart, engage core.
2
Lift knees alternately, tap with same side hand.
3
Continue rhythmically, maintain posture, increase speed as able.

name: Cardio Lateral Quick Feet
cardText:
1
Start with a shoulder width stance.
2
Quickly tap your feet while moving laterally.

name: Cardio Lateral Shuffle
cardText:
1
Start with a wide stance.
2
Shuffle sideways for a specified distance while maintaining a quarter squat position.

name: Cardio Long Jump
cardText:
1
Stand feet shoulder-width, knees slightly bent, arms behind you, eyes forward.
2
Swing arms backward, squat deeply, loading legs for explosive power.
3
Swing arms, explode forward, extend legs mid-air, land softly on both feet.

name: Cardio Long Jump Shuffle Back
cardText:
1
Stand feet shoulder-width, knees slightly bent, arms behind you, eyes forward.
2
Swing arms backward, squat deeply, loading legs for explosive power.
3
Swing arms, explode forward, extend legs mid-air, land softly on both feet.
4
Shuffle back to the starting position.

name: Cardio Quick Feet
cardText:
1
Quickly tap each foot to the ground.

name: Cardio Row Erg Rower Arms Only
cardText:
1
Make sure your feet are strapped in tightly.
2
Without bending your legs, pull the handle to your ribcage.
3
Fully extend your elbows before initiating the next rep.

name: Cardio Row Erg Rower Four Stroke Sprint Start
cardText:
1
Sit on seat, feet strapped in, grip handle with arms extended.
2
Push with legs, lean back slightly. Do four small pulls with increasing distance on each rep.
3
Extend arms, lean forward from hips, bend knees to return to start.

name: Cardio Row Erg Rower
cardText:
1
Sit on seat, feet strapped in, grip handle with arms extended.
2
Push with legs, lean back slightly, pull handle to lower ribs.
3
Extend arms, lean forward from hips, bend knees to return to start.

name: Cardio Row Erg Rower Legs Only
cardText:
1
Strap your feet in tightly.
2
Keep your arms extended while flexing and extending at the hips and knees.

name: Cardio Seal Jacks
cardText:
1
Stand with feet together, arms in front at chest level, palms touching.
2
Spread legs wide, simultaneously swing arms out to sides, palms facing forward.
3
Jump back to starting position, bringing arms together again quickly. Repeat rhythmically.

name: Cardio Shuttle Sprint
cardText:
1
Set up two cones at a specified distance.
2
Stay low and sprint quickly to the second cone.
3
Hinge forward and tap the cone, then turn and sprint to the original cone.
4
Repeat for the desired time or reps.

name: Cardio Single Leg Forward Hop
cardText:
1
Pick up one leg off the ground.
2
Hop forward and backward quickly while staying on your toes.

name: Cardio Single Leg Lateral Hop
cardText:
1
Pick up one leg off the ground.
2
Hop laterally quickly while staying on your toes.

name: Cardio Skater
cardText:
1
Stand, balance on right foot, left foot behind, slightly bent knees.
2
Jump to left, landing on left foot, right foot behind, swinging arms.
3
Continue leaping side-to-side, maintaining balance and speed, like a speed skater.

name: Cardio Skater To Single Leg Burpee
cardText:
1
Leap sideways, land on right foot, left leg behind to the side.
2
Drop into a single-leg burpee, right leg only, hands to ground.
3
Return to standing on right, leap sideways to left, repeat with left leg.

name: Cardio Ski Erg
cardText:
1
Leap sideways, land on right foot, left leg behind to the side.
2
Drop into a single-leg burpee, right leg only, hands to ground.
3
Return to standing on right, leap sideways to left, repeat with left leg.

name: Cardio Sprint In Place
cardText:
1
Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent, ready to move.
2
Quickly drive knees up towards chest, alternating legs, pumping arms in rhythm.
3
Gradually speed up, maintaining high knees and arm movement, breathe steadily.

name: Cardio Step Out Jacks
cardText:
1
Stand tall, feet together, arms by sides, ready to move.
2
Step right foot out, simultaneously raise arms above head.
3
Step right foot in, lower arms, repeat left, maintain rhythm.

name: Cardio Three Step Heismans
cardText:
1
Start with a shoulder width stance.
2
Stay on your toes, step right, tap your left toe to the ground, plant your right foot and raise your left leg.
3
Then repeat in the opposite direction.

name: Curve Treadmill
cardText:
1
Get the treadmill up to a comfortable speed where you are doing a walk.

name: Stair Climber
cardText:
1
Step onto step, grip handles lightly, maintain tall posture and neutral spine.
2
Drive through midfoot, alternate steps smoothly, avoid leaning heavily on handles.
3
Set moderate pace, breathe rhythmically, keep knees tracking over toes.

name: Treadmill Jog
cardText:
1
Get the treadmill up to a comfortable speed where you are doing a light jog.

name: Treadmill Sprint
cardText:
1
Get the treadmill up to a speed where you are doing a sprint.

name: Treadmill Walk
cardText:
1
Get the treadmill up to a comfortable speed where you are doing a walk.

name: Toe Tap
cardText:
1
Stand in front of a low box.
2
Bring one foot to the edge of the box and alternate as quickly as possible.
3
Only lightly tap your feet to the box.

name: Treadmill Backwards Walk
cardText:
1
Face the opposite direction on the treadmill.
2
Hold on to the arms to find your balance.
3
Walk backwards pushing your toes through the front of your shoes.

name: Treadmill Side Shuffle
cardText:
1
Face sideways on the treadmill.
2
Take a quarter squat position with a wide stance.
3
Shuffle sideways for a specified amount of time, then switch sides.
